name: Banner Knight's Class Bonus static +1 POWER buff
notes: Banner Knight's field-presence buff (GrandArchiveSim/Custom/GameLogic.php:11856-11871) is purely computed at ObjectCurrentPower() read time -- no flag or counter is ever stamped on the buffed object, which is why this card was previously logged as out of scope (no stored proof to assert via card_property_equals). Unblocked by adding a new 'computed_power_equals' assertion type to Core/RegressionTestFramework.php that calls ObjectCurrentPower() directly, the same function the engine's own combat/render code paths call -- reusable for the whole family of similarly-computed static auras (Exalted Dorumegian Throne, Seasoned Shieldmaster, Atmos Armor Type-Hermes, Banner Raccoon, etc. all share this shape) rather than being Banner-Knight-specific. [Class Bonus][Level 2+] requires a WARRIOR champion at level 2+; the starting champion's CardID is patched directly to Lorraine, Arclight Saber (level 3, WARRIOR) -- the same technique used by surged-coordinator-class-bonus-counters. Dungeon Guide (base POWER 1) is seeded onto the field as the buffed ally; expected computed power is 1 + 1 = 2.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus][Level 2+] Other allies and weapons you control get +1 [POWER].
